from_golden: UndereyeReelV5b (UndereyeReel_v5b): the patient's concern, the usual approach, his approach, the result
brief: A patient walkthrough: hook on the result and the patient's own setup-and-but (U3), the usual approach, what he does instead and why, the result. Before/after is labelled as an example of his approach, never as a diagnosis.

rules.faces: no slot box over a tracked face box

slots.note: within 1.5 s (hook rule L8); placed in the face-free band
one card per argument beat, on its key word +1 f; sequential handover, one card on screen
a named condition gets a real example: the face region punched in a glass window (L6)
a named instrument/product: the real cut-out from public/objects (never AI); missing -> WISHLIST + argument card
